title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Sales & Business Growth

Team Leadership

What We’re Looking For

  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.

Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
We Are Sportingtech :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In:

As the JAVA Engineering Team Lead , you will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of talented developers, overseeing the development and maintenance of our Java-based gaming platform. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions. Your role will involve a combination of hands-on development, technical leadership, and strategic planning.

The impact you will have:

  • You will be responsible for leading, motivating, and developing a team of engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • You will oversee the complete development cycle of the Java gaming platform, ensuring quality, security, and best practices.
  • You will collaborate with managers and principal engineers in defining requirements, deadlines, and strategic technical decisions.
  • You will be required to monitor project progress, remove blockers, and ensure timely deliveries aligned with business objectives.
  • You will also participate in code review, complex troubleshooting, and the promotion of continuous improvement for the team and its processes.

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, Agile methodologies, and DevOps tools.
  • Advanced English.
  • Good communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills are essential.
  • Knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut) and SQL databases is also valued.
  • This role is Remote based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Product Owner
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!

A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.

Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.

Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!

Principais Responsabilidades:

Definir a visão e a estratégia do produto de Faturamento convênio, alinhando os objetivos do produto com as metas e prioridades da organização;

Gerenciar os requisitos do produto, identificando e priorizando funcionalidades que atendam às necessidades do mercado e dos stakeholders, com foco na melhoria contínua do processo de faturamento;

Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, facilitando a comunicação entre as áreas envolvidas e garantindo que os requisitos do produto sejam compreendidos e atendidos;

Planejar e coordenar os lançamentos do produto, garantindo que todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do produto sejam executadas de acordo com os prazos estabelecidos e com a qualidade exigida;

Analisar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para aprimorar o produto e garantir a sua competitividade.

Requisitos Técnicos:

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Administração, Enfermagem ou áreas afins;

Pós-graduação em Gerenciamento de Produtos ou áreas relacionadas será diferencial;

Conhecimento aprofundado em processos hospitalares e jornada do paciente;

Entendimento sobre conceitos de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais, especialmente no contexto da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD);

Conhecimento em normas e padrões de qualidade, como ISO 27001 (Gestão de Segurança da Informação) e ISO 9001 (Gestão da Qualidade);

Habilidade em análise de riscos, com foco na identificação e mitigação de riscos legais, operacionais e de compliance;

Capacidade de criar e manter documentação técnica e legal relacionada ao produto e seus processos;

Conhecimento de regulamentações específicas dos setores de saúde, financeiro e educação, com ênfase no cumprimento de requisitos legais e regulatórios.

title: Analista GIS Sênior (ArcGIS) (Presencial São Paulo/SP)
description:
Vaga de atuação presencial no Cliente, localizado em São Paulo/SP.

Descrição da vaga

O profissional deverá suportar tecnicamente a equipe técnica do cliente, executando as atividades relacionadas a configuração, manutenção e melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS, apresentadas a seguir:

• Instalação e configuração de softwares nativos plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Atualização de versão e configuração de softwares plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Administração dos dados armazenados nos Ambientes ArcGIS Enterprise e Online;

• Demonstrações de utilização da plataforma ArcGIS Enterprise, incluindo Apps; • prontas para uso (Survey123, Dashboard, etc.);

• Mentoring e acompanhamento dos usuários da plataforma ArcGIS;

• Explicação sobre a utilização de extensões;

• Publicação e gestão dos serviços de mapas no ArcGIS Enterprise ou ArcGIS Online;

• Publicação de geoprocessing no ArcGIS Enterprise;

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Prestar apoio no planejamento executivo dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no ArcGIS Pro, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;
  • Utilizar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS, como ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos, aplicando os principais componentes e funcionalidades da Plataforma ArcGIS (Server, Mobile, Desktop, Online e extensões) e ter habilidade de identificar onde ela se aplica;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicar elementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Propor a escala de trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
  • Resolver problemas de distorções e compreender características específicas de dados geográficos, cuja origem esteja relacionada com a fonte;
  • Ter domínio das funcionalidades do ArcGIS e propor melhorias na utilização das ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos e auxiliar a equipe;
  • Propor melhorias no uso das ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Domínio das principais extensões do ArcGIS e propor utilizações inovadoras na utilização das principais extensões;
  • Criar e estruturar novas metodologias de execução de serviços de geoprocessamento, estimativas e controle de qualidade conforme as características específicas a serem executadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Conhecimentos das soluções e produtos ESRI (ArcGIS Pro e Apps, ArcGIS Enterprise e ArcGIS Online);
  • Compreensão referente a origem e conceitos básicos das tecnologias e metodologias para aquisição de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de projeção (UTM, Lambert) e datums geográficos (WGS84, SIRGAS2000);
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de metadados existentes.

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Conhecimento de CAD;
  • Conhecimento de softwares de PDI;
  • Conhecimento em Sensoriamento Remoto, Geodésia, Cartografia, Análise Espacial, SIG’s e GIS Web;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

  • Elaborar relatórios e manter registros de negociações e atividades de clientes.

  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficientes.

  • Organização.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.

Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: 拉美巴西区域HR负责人
description:
核心职责

1. 人力资源战略与业务伙伴：

- 深入理解拉美各重点国家（如巴西）的业务战略与挑战，提供前瞻性、可落地的人力资源规划和解方案。

- 领导拉美巴西区域的全周期招聘工作，为重点和关键岗位制定高效的招聘策略。

- 建立并优化区域招聘渠道和流程，提升招聘效率和候选人体验。

- 确保人才梯队的健康构建，满足业务快速发展对各类人才的需求。

3. 绩效管理与人才发展：

- 主导实施绩效管理体系（如OKR），并确保其在本地得到有效落地和优化。

- 建立区域人才盘点机制，识别高潜人才，制定并推动关键人才的培养、发展和留任计划。

- 设计与业务目标紧密关联的培训发展体系，提升员工整体能力素质。

4. 员工关系与企业文化：

- 营造积极、包容、高绩效的企业文化，提升员工敬业度和组织凝聚力。

- 处理复杂的员工关系问题，确保公司在巴西的雇佣实践完全符合当地法律法规。

- 建立有效的内部沟通机制，确保公司价值观和战略在区域内的有效传递。

5. 薪酬福利与HR运营：

- 管理拉美巴西区域的薪酬福利体系，进行市场薪酬调研，确保薪酬策略在市场上的竞争力与内部的公平性。

- 优化HR运营流程，提升HR服务效率和员工体验。

- 管理与本地PEO（专业雇主组织）或HR外包服务商的合作（如适用）。

6. 合规与风险管理：

- 全面负责巴西的人力资源合规性，包括但不限于劳动法、税务、社保等，规避用工风险。

- 及时更新各国劳动法规政策变化，并对业务进行预警和指导。

任职要求

必备条件：

- 本科及以上学历，人力资源、管理学、心理学或相关专业。

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

-精通葡萄牙语优先，英语能作为工作语言。

- 对拉美巴西的劳动法、雇佣实践、社保体系和商业文化有深入理解和实操经验。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。

优先考虑：

- 有在(您所在的行业，如：科技、互联网、制造业等)公司的工作经验。

- 有从0到1搭建区域HR体系的经验。

- 拥有在复杂跨国公司矩阵式组织结构中工作的经验。

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

A large telecommunications company is looking for a candidate that will be responsible for maintaining the stability and reliability of network services through advanced technical expertise and proactive coordination. title: IT Business Analyst - Transportation Management
description:
Position Summary

The Solution Delivery Organization is fully aligned with ADM’s enterprise process framework and the AE/GPO (Accountable Executive/Global Process Owner) structure, supporting business technology strategy development, solution discovery, service management, risk mitigation and relationship management.

Within the Transportation Management (TM) domain, the team enables all processes and capabilities related to planning, execution, visibility and optimization of transportation.

As part of the TM Solution Delivery team, the Senior Business Analyst – TM will analyze business processes, gather functional requirements, and collaborate with Solution Leaders, Process & System Analysts, and business stakeholders to design, document, and deliver robust TM solutions that support ADM’s global strategy.

Job Responsibilities

• Partner with Product Owners, business representatives and Solution Delivery team members during preliminary investigations for new solutions, ensuring clear requirements gathering, data analysis and evaluation of solution options.

• Support business case development by providing process and functional expertise to define expected business outcomes.

• Contribute to the design and revision of processes following enterprise governance standards.

• Understand cross-process and cross-functional dependencies while designing, developing and implementing TM solutions.

• Prepare documentation for key project phases, including requirement gathering, discovery, development and delivery.

• Collaborate with Solution Architects to translate strategy documents into actionable roadmaps and participate in regular roadmap reviews.

• Work closely with other IT delivery teams to ensure efficient end-to-end solution deployment.

• Collaborate with external vendors (software, applications, tools) to clarify business requirements and support system analysts in building functionalities.

• Support roadmap execution for implementation projects, ensuring alignment with stakeholders and service delivery teams.

• Maintain high visibility on solution and service delivery activities through updates, meetings and communication with team leads.

• Analyze incoming requests, ensuring deliverables are well defined and aligned with stakeholders.

• Provide accurate status updates and documentation for assigned projects, enhancements and support activities.

• Contribute to estimates of time and resource needs for proposed solutions.

• Support transition of project deliverables into the support organization through documentation and knowledge transfer.

• Partner with other process and system experts to identify continuous improvement opportunities.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business or related field, with 5+ years of experience in IT or business process roles.

• Strong understanding of Transportation Management processes (planning, execution, carrier management, freight visibility), and familiarity with major TM solutions.

• Ability to interact professionally with all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.

• Ability to work occasional weekends, holidays or overtime when necessary.

• Willingness to travel to support business objectives.

• Ability to work independently and in multicultural teams.

• Strong analytical, organizational, time-management, facilitation and process-management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments, reprioritize, and handle evolving assignments.

• Knowledge of emerging trends and process solutions related to Transportation Management.

• Fluency in Portuguese and English .

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy , policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)

About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

  • Diagnosticar e solucionar defeitos das disciplinas voltadas a mecânica pneumática, hidráulica dos equipamentos mecânicos da fábrica;
  • Elaborar relatórios, descrevendo os problemas detectados, suas causas básicas e como devem ser direcionados;
  • Elaborar RFCA através de relatórios; investigar e analisar falhas a fim de determinar a causa raiz dos problemas relacionados à manutenção ou desenho;
  • Controlar o almoxarifado, garantindo rotatividade das peças, eficácia na armazenagem, controle e disponibilidade;
  • Controlar o empréstimo de ferramentas garantindo conservação e disponibilidade;
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas a fim de garantir os índices de manutenção saudáveis e eficientes, gerando mais disponibilidade para a fábrica;
  • Montar e fazer manutenção em tubulações, bombas e motores; Cumprir com os treinamentos aplicáveis ao cargo;
  • Checar diariamente as ordens de manutenção disponíveis no CMMS;
  • Contatar fornecedores para garantir spare parts críticos da manutenção, baseando-se no prazo de entrega e fabricação do equipamento.

Requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Técnico em Mecânica, Técnico em Manutenção Industrial e/ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável :

  • Conhecimento em análise de vibração, lubrificação, leitura e interpretação de P&ID;
  • Conhecimento em integridade mecânica, NR-13, conhecimento em bombas de deslocamento positivos: helicoidais, engrenagem, lóbulo, bombas centrifugas;
  • Conhecimento em Excel, Autocad.

Local da Vaga: Salto/SP

Sobre a Stepan:

Fundada em 1932, a Stepan Company é uma importante fabricante de produtos químicos básicos e intermediários, incluindo surfactantes, polímeros, bem como ingredientes especiais que entram em produtos de consumo, domésticos e institucionais, como detergentes para roupas, xampus e limpadores de superfícies. A Stepan Company possui atualmente 20 fábricas globais e mais de 2.000 funcionários. Temos um forte histórico de crescimento. Nosso crescimento nos permite oferecer oportunidades de carreira significativas e estabilidade aos membros de nossa equipe. Temos grandes objetivos na Stepan e sabemos que cada membro da equipe será crucial para alcançar nossos objetivos. Independentemente da função, procuramos membros da equipe que tragam consigo uma mentalidade de crescimento, um espírito empreendedor e a capacidade de prosperar em um ambiente em evolução.

Celebramos a diversidade na Stepan e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente diversificado e inclusivo. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, informações genéticas, deficiência, idade, status de veterano ou qualquer outro status protegido pela lei aplicável.

title: Analista de CS (Sucesso do cliente)
description:

A pessoa será responsável por garantir uma experiência de excelência aos nossos clientes ao atuar como ponto de contato principal, solucionar dúvidas e gerir relacionamentos. Qualificações

  • Habilidades Analíticas: É necessário possuir competências para análise de dados e resolução de problemas, com foco em identificar tendências e propor melhorias nos processos.

Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados a jornada de trabalho, produtividade, SLA e eficiência operacional.

title: Líder de vendas
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:

Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:

• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

• Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

description:

Sua expertise será fundamental para reduzirmos progressivamente as restrições de vendas, transformando cada análise em uma oportunidade de maximizar receita.

title: D2C Projects & New Business Manager LATAM
description:
D2C Projects & New Business Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Description

Together with Samsung LATAM Countries, the role will be responsible for the development, sales and overall performance of the main D2C sales programs and new business projects, leading the following pillars/strategic areas:

  • Sales Operations: Promote eStore capabilities and coordinate key initiatives along with internal platform/product teams or external partners, aiming to achieve D2C main targets.
  • D2C Sell-out Platforms Management: Strengthen LATAM D2C exclusive programs (such as: Trade-in, Co-Branded Card, Extended Warranty, Installation Service), enabling the sales growth and targets achievement.
  • New Business Projects: Define innovative programs based on sell-out platforms such as subscription models and value-added services and draw the commercial strategies to execute and grow them.
  • CRP: Customer Retention Program ambassador in LATAM D2C, engaging all subsidiary in the company’s strategy and promoting the alignment and projects execution with CS and related stakeholders.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Define, track, report and engage LATAM Countries to implement the regional/global Sell-out enablers strategy, and ensure the main KPIs achievement.
  • Define the sell-out programs sales strategy by working with the business areas to implement the promotional and forecast plan.
  • Ensure the sell-out programs’ financial sustainability while balancing an attractive promotional agenda with business profitability.
  • Support in marketing / UX strategies for the sell-out enablers launch and enhancement, ensuring the correct communication and display of programs for brand consumers.
  • Act as a PMO of regional projects that focus on accelerating D2C performance.
  • Together with Samsung subsidiaries in LATAM, act in the management of partnerships that make up the digital online channel ecosystem.
  • Prospect regional partnerships and co-lead the deployment of those along with the subsidiaries.
  • In conjunction with the IT team, manage the D2C sell-out projects roadmap, responding by the business assessment, development, execution, GTM and usability of the tools.
  • Manage the continuous improvement agenda of the D2C programs, focusing on user experience and increasing of conversion.
  • Integration with CS Team and related areas to promote CRP (Customer Retention Program) agenda in D2C LATAM, engaging eStore Business and Commercial teams to implement the regional strategy.
  • Executive report on sell-out programs strategies and business results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Administration, Business Administration, or related areas.
  • Experience in Online sales management and digital environment.
  • Experience in commercial department or sales planning.
  • Management/operation of e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong skills in communication and project management.
  • Master presentation and report skills, structured by deep data analysis.
  • Ease in dealing with complex database in Excel.
  • Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus).

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Estagiário de Design gráfico (Indústrial)
description:

- Compõe a lista de materiais; elabora procedimento/roteiro de fabricação; suporta tecnicamente o setor de vendas no que diz respeito à imagem dos clientes e suporta tecnicamente o processo produtivo.

- Elaboração das listas de materiais e roteiros para fabricação de produtos industriais;

- Gerenciamento e atualização da documentação de aprovações dos layouts gráficos;

- Análise, tratamento e resposta para relatórios de ação corretiva (RAC’s) direcionados ao setor gráfico;

- Análises técnicas para liberação de holds;

- Disponibilização de programas para impressão digital;

- Desenvolvimento de especificações gráficas (RGS e Brand Specs);

- Análises de part numbers para a área de Serviços;

- Desenvolvimento de imagens para adesivos não produtivos;

- Desenvolvimento de imagens para Tradeshow;

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. title: Data Engineer

You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Risk Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks across the organization.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing、scenario analysis、capital adequacy evaluations and other regulatory-mandated reviews.
  • Prepare, validate, and support all regulatory disclosures required of financial institutions and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) , ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Margin-Account Risk Oversight

  • Lead the governance and oversight of margin-account operations , including:
  • Establishing risk policies for margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Defining and periodically reviewing maximum LTV ratios and haircut methodologies ;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring adherence to client and institutional exposure limits, capital buffers, and net-worth thresholds.
  • Continuously monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) across business functions, escalating breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board with clear remediation plans.
  • Operate as an independent second-line function , maintaining objectivity from commercial and trading activities while collaborating closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology.
  • Engage with internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and governance committees on matters related to risk management, capital adequacy, and prudential standards.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware culture by supporting ongoing training, communication, and enhancements to risk methodologies, models, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level experience in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within banks, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and proven capability operating as a second-line or independent control function .
  • Strong command of Central Bank of Brazil risk regulations, prudential rules, capital adequacy requirements, and VASP reporting obligations.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks , stress testing, scenario modeling, and margin-account governance involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field; postgraduate qualifications are strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, strong quantitative capabilities, excellent communication, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.

Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;

Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;

Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.

Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.

Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.

title: Business Development Manager, Mining Segment
description:
Position Overview

We seek a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Sales Manager to lead sales operations and business expansion in Brazil Region. This role is critical in driving market share growth within the mining sector, focusing on large OTR (Off-The-Road) tire solutions for heavy mining equipment. The ideal candidate must possess extensive mining industry networks, a hunter mentality for new business acquisition, and proven experience managing key accounts in demanding environments.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development

  • Identify, target, and secure new clients in the mining industry across Brazil
  • Develop and execute growth strategies to achieve annual sales targets and market penetration goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers at mining corporations.

Key Account Management

  • Serve as the primary contact for Tier-1 mining clients.
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews to ensure client satisfaction and identify upsell opportunities.
  • Resolve complex client issues through technical expertise and resource coordination.

Market Intelligence & Expansion

  • Analyze competitor activities and market trends to refine pricing, product positioning, and value propositions.
  • Explore growth opportunities in adjacent sectors (quarrying, construction, ports).

Sales Operations Leadership

  • Manage the networks and field sales teams to ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Monitor KPIs (revenue growth, profit margins, market share) and report biweekly to regional leadership.

Field Engagement

  • Spend ≥70% of time traveling to mining sites for technical consultations, audits, and contract negotiations.
  • Lead on-site troubleshooting for tire performance and safety challenges.

Qualifications & Requirements

Mandatory

  • Work Authorization: Valid right to work in Indonesia
  • Industry Expertise:
  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in mining sectors.
  • Established network with mining operations, procurement heads, and fleet managers.
  • Sales Competency:
  • Demonstrated record of achieving >20% YoY growth in complex sales environments.
  • Expertise in large account development (> ZAR 50M contracts).
  • Personal Attributes:
  • Resilient, self-motivated, and able to thrive in high-pressure settings.
  • Physically fit to navigate remote mining sites and endure extended travel (up to 4 weeks/month).
  • Language: Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Technical knowledge of OTR tires or heavy machinery.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • Travel allowance, fuel card,
  • Performance bonuses and career advancement opportunities.
  • Global career opportunity

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
PROJECT QUALITY ENGINEER

Reports to: Quality Coordinator

Role Summary

- Assists with the interpretation of project-specific Quality Assurance requirements, verifies Quality Assurance plan implementation, and evaluates effectiveness by audits and assessments.

- Responsible for verification of design, procurement, manufacturing, site activities, tests, inclusion of appropriate inspections and their acceptance criteria into project documentation that will be deployed into the Supply Chain.

- Ensure that Quality is being incorporated into projects and processes (prevention), rather than inspected.

Key tasks of the Position

  • Reviews customers’ specifications, further legal / statutory requirements (Q related) and compare to industries standards aiming to identify main relationships and differences (if any), ensure proper requirements' management and compliance.
  • Reviews / issues project-specific Quality Plans and documentation (e.g.: Inspection & Test Plans, etc).
  • Supports, facilitates, reviews and releases project-specific Design & Process FMEAs, verification and validation reports, ensuring proper method application, risk analysis & classification, actions definition and their implementation.
  • Ensure project lessons learned (positive and negative) are produced and management system changes are implemented, as necessary.
  • Supports the development of project-specific sourcing & manufacturing strategies and schedules, ensuring that all relevant quality activities and requirements are considered and consistent to the strategies.
  • Participates on key project related meetings (e.g.: Design reviews) providing quality related input;
  • Ensure through process audits & verifications (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) and based on project-specific data analysis that quality is being incorporated in processes.
  • Drives, supports, and facilitates continuous improvement activities (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) based on project-specific data analysis.
  • Performs Technical Committee meetings prior components' release for shipping.
  • Supports, review and releases the Project-specific Quality Data book
  • Monitor the Project Quality Budget and to inform the Project Manager and the Project Quality Coordinator accordingly (eg compliance with Sales Forecast value; proceeding in case of deviations).

Additional responsabilities

  • Supports, on demand and based on his/her capabilities, Quality department's tasks & priorities defined by the Quality Engineering Coordinator & Head of Quality
  • Occasional Business Trips: ~ 20% of time

Decision-Making Powers

  • Full empowerment for rejection or blockage of processes and/or components when those are not compliant to the expected Quality requirements.
  • Power of tasks assignment (e.g.: start of a problem-solving activity) based on project-specific data analysis

EMPLOYEE PROFILE

Professional Experience & Education

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Material, as applicable) or equivalent.
  • Postgraduate in Business Administration (desirable).
  • Relevant work experience in Quality Management & Quality Engineering.
  • Relevant professional experience and knowledge in business processes as well as in non-quality functions like Manufacturing, Logistics, Engineering, Purchasing.
  • Certified Lead Auditor (e.g. ISO 9001 and ISO 19011) (desirable).
  • Qualification in electrical and/or, dimensional and/or, NDT testing (desirable).

Specific Skills & Knowledge (Ex: Language, IT skills)

  • Practical knowledge in using IT-tools: SharePoint, SAP, MS Office, database tracking programs.
  • Good Lean Management background is an advantage.
  • Management and communication skills (incl. but not limited to interpersonal, listening, verbal, written, didactic and presentation).
  • English fluent, written and spoken (additional languages are an advantage).
  • Strong analytical expertise as well as result-oriented, solution driven (pragmatic) and customer oriented working principle.
  • Experienced and willingness to work and cooperate in cross functional teams

title: Manager, PX Business Partner LATAM
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, PX Business Partner LATAM, will bring our human capital strategy to life by partnering with the organization on key initiatives. The role works closely with departments to solve challenges, lead change, and provide counsel and guidance on team memner matters. This role is the go-to person for both strategic advice and operational PX needs for our LATAM-based team members.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with designated departments, providing strategic support across the full team member lifecycle—from hiring to development to offboarding.
  • Lead tier 1 team member relations investigations and resolution processes, ensuring fair and productive outcomes in compliance with company policies and employment law.
  • Drive performance management by coaching leaders on feedback practices, accountability measures, and promoting high-impact development conversations.
  • Support job design and organizational planning, helping leaders clarify roles, build effective teams, and plan for future staffing needs.
  • Collaborate with internal centers of excellence partners (e.g., Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development) to execute PX programs, ensuring alignment within PX and the human capital strategic plan.
  • Analyze PX data and KPIs (e.g., attrition, engagement survey results, internal mobility) to guide decision-making and recommend improvements.
  • Champion company culture through the facilitation of team member engagement initiatives, events, recognition efforts, and inclusive workplace programs.
  • Coach leaders through change management efforts, such as restructures, role changes, or system implementations, with attention to communication and team member experience.
  • Serve as a project lead or contributor on enterprise PX initiatives, including policy development, system upgrades, or organizational assessments.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

DEGREE TYPE: Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY: Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or related field of study

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive HR related experience.
  • At least one year of supervisory/management experience.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Strong knowledge of HR practices and Brazilian employment laws
  • Ability to influence and coach leaders at all levels
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable handling sensitive issues with professionalism and discretion
  • Strong analytical and project management capabilities

Somos um dos escritórios de advocacia mais respeitados do Brasil e da América Latina. Com mais de 75 anos de existência, nunca nos afastamos do nosso objetivo principal e compromisso de longo prazo: oferecer serviços jurídicos com o mais alto padrão de qualidade e excelência, prestados por advogados altamente motivados para contribuir com o sucesso comercial de nossos clientes.

Estamos em busca de um(a) advogado para integrar o time de Mineração.

Somos comprometidos com Diversidade e Inclusão e encorajamos todos os candidatos que se considerem aptos tecnicamente para esta vaga a se inscreverem. Gostou? Então, veja abaixo as principais responsabilidades e atribuições para esta posição.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir due diligence de ativos minerários para diversos tipos de transação;
  • Participar em projetos de M&A e estruturação de projetos minerários;
  • Realizar pesquisas aprofundadas sobre legislação mineral, jurisprudência e doutrina para subsidiar relatórios e pareceres;
  • Elaborar pareceres e relatórios relacionadas ao direito minerário;
  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos relacionados à projetos minerários (cessão de direitos minerários, contratos de arrendamento, garantia e financiamento, entre outros);
  • Apoio na conciliação de interesses entre empresas de mineração e demais stakeholders, quando necessário;
  • Apoio em processos judiciais envolvendo projetos minerários;
  • Interagir com órgão regulador e acompanhar processos administrativos relacionados à mineração, incluindo a elaboração de defesas e recursos administrativos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Direito;
  • Inglês Fluente;
  • OAB Ativa.

Informações adicionais:

  • Regime de trabalho híbrido;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Viagem;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Participação nos Lucros;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub e Clube de benefícios;
  • Presente de Casamento;
  • Day-Off no Aniversário.

title: Gerente de sucesso do cliente
description:
A RPE tem como objetivo viabilizar o amplo crescimento dos negócios varejistas e da economia nacional por meio de soluções ágeis, robustas, seguras e integradas a todo ecossistema de serviços financeiros.

Com mais de oitenta profissionais especialistas em tecnologia e meios de pagamento, atendemos mais de quarenta negócios varejistas, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas para a democratização do crédito nos pontos de vendas.

Se você está pronto para crescer e voar com a gente, esta é sua chance!

O Gerente de Sucesso Cliente será responsável por garantir a execução, evolução e sustentabilidade dos resultados dos emissores ao longo de toda a jornada do cliente. Será o ponto de liderança direta do time de CSMs, assegurando performance, disciplina operacional, qualidade das entregas e geração de valor contínuo para cada emissor.

Essa posição exige forte capacidade relacional, habilidade de influenciar diversas áreas internas e maturidade para transformar rituais, cadências e insights de clientes em ações práticas que impulsionem retenção, expansão e eficiência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderança e Gestão de Time

  • Liderar diretamente o time de CSMs, assegurando execução consistente, alinhamento estratégico e foco em resultados.
  • Realizar acompanhamento de performance individual e coletiva, estabelecendo metas claras e planos de desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Desenvolver competências essenciais do time, como discurso de valor, storytelling, negociação, visão analítica e postura consultiva.

Gestão da Operação de CS

  • Garantir a execução das rotinas de Customer Success conforme rituais da área (QBR, MBR, cadências, playbooks).
  • Analisar insumos extraídos desses rituais, transformando dados em insights que direcionem priorizações, ações corretivas e estratégias de engajamento.

Entrega de Valor ao Emissor

  • Garantir que cada emissor avance em sua jornada, com foco em sucesso operacional, captura de receita e uso eficiente dos produtos.
  • Atuar como facilitador entre o emissor e as áreas internas da RPE, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e resolução de demandas críticas.

Resultados e Governança

  • Assegurar execução e previsibilidade das atividades da equipe, garantindo visão clara de riscos, oportunidades e prioridades.
  • Contribuir na construção de estratégias de retenção, expansão e viabilidade financeira dos contratos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em Customer Success, Account Management, preferencialmente em serviços B2B em tecnologia, meios de pagamento e/ou serviços financeiros;
  • Vivência prévia como líder de times de relacionamento, vendas, atendimento ou CS;
  • Forte capacidade relacional, estabelecendo e fortalecendo o relacionamento com executivos e decisores dos clientes da RPE;
  • Experiência com rotinas estruturadas de CS: QBR, MBR e Comitês de Clientes;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade de conduzir conversas executivas e narrativas orientadas a valor (storytelling);
  • Capacidade comprovada de priorização, gestão de múltiplas demandas e tomada de decisão em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Facilidade para atuar de forma colaborativa com Produto, Tech, Suporte, Operações e Comercial; e
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CS, CRM, BI e análise de dados (ex.: CustomerX, Pipe Drive, Sense Data, Sales Force, HubSpot ou similar).

Informações adicionais

  • Regime de contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, indo 2x por semana no escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia/SP.

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.

About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment

End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.

Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: GERENTE DE EXPANSÃO (CENTRO OESTE, NORTE)
description:
GERENTE DE EXPANSÃO - CENTRO OESTE, NORTE

O Gerente de Expansão será responsável por conduzir todo o ciclo de abertura de novas unidades, desde a prospecção de oportunidades comerciais até a aprovação de franqueados e acompanhamento da implantação das lojas. Atuará de forma estratégica junto à diretoria, garantindo uma expansão sustentável, organizada e alinhada às diretrizes da rede.

Atividades:

Prospecção e Análise de Pontos Comerciais

• Realizar mapeamento de cidades e mercados potenciais para expansão.

• Prospectar pontos comerciais por meio de reuniões com shoppings centers imobiliárias, comerciantes locais e franqueados aprovados.

• Solicitar cotações, reservas e visitas técnicas aos pontos mapeados.

• Avaliar características comerciais, estratégicas e operacionais de cada ponto identificado.

Apresentação de Propostas e Negociações

• Elaborar propostas de locação e materiais de apresentação de cidades e pontos comerciais ao comitê de empreendedores e diretoria.

• Conduzir negociações com imobiliárias e shoppings, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes comerciais e financeiras da empresa.

• Acompanhar revisões contratuais até a assinatura dos contratos de locação.

Atendimento e Gestão de Leads

• Atender leads em conjunto com o time de SDR, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre perfil desejado, regiões disponíveis e funcionamento do processo de franquia.

• Acompanhar o funil de expansão e garantir uma jornada clara e organizada para os candidatos.

Integração e Treinamento

• Solicitar e acompanhar a inscrição dos novos franqueados no programa de integração e treinamento.

• Garantir que iniciem a fase de implantação preparados operacionalmente.

Formalização Jurídica

• Solicitar documentos necessários para elaboração da COF e do Contrato de Franquia.

• Acompanhar validação e aprovação junto ao departamento jurídico.

Acompanhamento das Obras

• Monitorar o andamento das obras de implantação.

• Intervir junto ao franqueado, locador e equipe técnica para garantir cumprimento de prazos.

Monitoramento de Indicadores

• Acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho da expansão.

• Auxiliar a diretoria na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Relatórios e Apresentações

• Elaborar relatórios mensais destacando avanços, desafios e oportunidades da expansão.

• Realizar apresentações semanais à diretoria com mapeamentos e status dos pontos

comerciais.

• Participar das reuniões de acompanhamento da implantação de novas lojas.

• Colaborar na solução de problemas e nas tomadas de decisão.

Feiras e Eventos

• Apoiar a organização de Feiras de Franquias e eventos institucionais.

• Participar da ABF Expo e outras ações de relacionamento.

Requisitos:

• Formação Superior completa;

• Disponibilidade para Viagens;

• Experiencia mínima de 5 anos na área de expansão e franquias;

Base de Trabalho: Preferencialmente em Brasília ou Goiânia
